summary_en: Proposes a Sigmoid-regularized optimal-transport full-waveform inversion framework for ring-array ultrasound computed tomography. The method jointly reconstructs sound speed and attenuation, uses a 2-Wasserstein misfit to reduce cycle skipping, and reports maximum relative errors of 3.8% and 5.1% for sound speed and attenuation together with experimental lesion-region agreement of 92.6% Dice against reference imaging.
